notes: No genuine Christmas/Eid/Ramadan/Diwali/Halloween/Valentine/Easter/Thanksgiving/New Year/Holi/Rakhi/Navratri/Dussehra or other seasonal-holiday product category exists on the AE storefront as of 2026-09-03. Direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi with Chrome impersonation) was blocked by an Akamai bot-detection challenge on every URL, so access moved to tier 2: a non-headless Playwright/patchright browser (headless mode also returned Access Denied; non-headless rendered normally, status 200). Checked: (1) full rendered mega-menu via https://www.zarahome.com/ae/sitemap.html, which lists every top-level nav branch and all of its sub-category links (474 link entries covering New In, Bedding, Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen and Dining, Bathroom, Fragrances, Kids and Baby, Clothing and Footwear, Laundry Care, Pets Collection, Gym Collection, Books, Special Collection, Editorials, Culinary Stories) - no Christmas/holiday/festive/Eid/Ramadan/Diwali branch present anywhere in this tree, no local-language (Arabic) seasonal nav item either. (2) The site's own AE-specific category sitemap (robots.txt -> sitemap-index-home-categories-zh.xml -> sitemap-home-categories-zh-ae-0.xml.gz, 592 category URLs total, fetched and decompressed directly) scanned for christmas/xmas/eid/ramadan/diwali/deepavali/holiday/festive/festival/halloween/valentine/easter/thanksgiving/new-year/holi/rakhi/navratri/dussehra/gift/season/winter/summer/spring/autumn/fall/special/event/celebrat keywords. Only seasonal-sounding hits: 'christmas-editorial-2-n4588' (its own page data identifies it as a repurposed legacy slug now serving the unrelated 'Culinary Stories with Imogen Kwok and Thierry Boutemy' editorial content, seo.irrelevant=true, isCanonicalReference=true - not a Christmas category and not a product listing page, excluded per core rules NEVER EXTRACT/editorial); 'winter-duvet-n4965' and 'bedspreads-summer-n4877', which are standalone bedding product lines named for thermal weight/season (a duck-down winter-weight duvet, a lightweight summer bedspread), not nodes under any Winter/Summer holiday-shopping category and with no parent seasonal branch anywhere in the nav - excluded per Rule 5/6 (seasonal-sounding product name != seasonal category). No Eid, Ramadan, or Diwali content of any kind was found despite this being a UAE-market storefront - Zara Home's category taxonomy for AE is identical to its other markets with no region-specific festival branch. (3) A live internal-search discrimination check (site search for christmas/eid/diwali via /ae/search?term=) confirms the same absence: 'eid' and 'diwali' both redirected the browser to /ae/error.html?term=... (the site's own no-match/invalid-term handling), and 'christmas' returned the search page with no product-count text anywhere on it (no results). None of the three terms surfaced a genuine seasonal PLP. robots.txt has no Claude-specific (anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot) disallow, so no policy_opt_out applies.
